method: test S4 (real append+flush between reads) plus a source reading of JsonlSessionHandle.read/readCurrent and the documented SessionHandle ordering contract
documentedContract: reads concurrent with a mutation carry no ordering promise beyond the valid contiguous prefix; a torn physical tail is never returned; repeated reads on one handle never observe an older state than a prior read
verdict: PASS — an already-observed read boundary is never retroactively reclassified by later storage growth
note: this is a controlled, deterministic append AFTER a completed read, not a proven nondeterministic concurrent-writer race; the ruling forbids presenting a source inference as a reproduced race
